title: Leave and notice policy
author: Amina Yusuf
text:
# Leave and notice policy
Owner: Amina Yusuf (People operations). Approved by Hana Okafor. Effective 1 July 2026. Applies to all permanent staff in Singapore, Japan and India.

## Annual leave
- Every permanent employee gets 21 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accrued monthly.
- Up to 5 unused days carry over to the next year and expire on 31 March.
- Book leave in the HR system at least two weeks ahead for anything longer than three days, and tell your manager in your team channel.
- Public holidays follow the office you are employed in.

## Sick leave
- 14 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is needed for absences longer than two consecutive days.

## Notice period
- The notice period when you resign is 30 days for individual contributors and 60 days for leads and heads.
- During probation (the first three months) the notice period is 7 days on either side.
- Unused annual leave can be offset against the notice period only with your manager's written approval.

## Who to ask
Amina Yusuf for leave and notice questions. Your manager approves leave; Hana Okafor approves exceptions to the notice period.

title: Customer refund and service credit policy
author: Nur Aziz
text:
# Customer refund and service credit policy
Owner: Nur Aziz (Finance). Reviewed with Daniel Lim (Customer) and Jiwon Park for contract terms. Effective 12 August 2026.

## Refunds
- Route Lens is billed monthly per workspace. Customers can cancel at any time; the current month is not refunded.
- Annual prepaid contracts can be refunded pro rata only within the first 30 days of the term.
- Refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 10 business days.

## Service credits
- If monthly availability falls below the SLA in the customer's contract, the customer gets a service credit: 10 percent of that month's fee below 99.5 percent, 25 percent below 99.0 percent.
- Credits are applied to the next invoice, never paid as cash, and must be requested within 30 days of the month end.
- The Support SLA tiers page defines response targets; this page defines money.

## Approvals
- Account executives can approve credits up to USD 500. Above that, Nur Aziz approves. Anything above USD 5,000 also needs Hana Okafor.

title: AI coding agents policy
author: Mei Tan
text:
# AI coding agents policy
Owner: Mei Tan (Engineering). Security review: Jiwon Park. Approved at the September engineering leads review. Effective 22 September 2026.

Engineers may use AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex on Northwind repositories, under these rules:

1. Agents must check the company record before they act. Every agent session is connected to Canon over MCP, and the agent calls check_intent before it changes deploy schedules, infrastructure, access rules or anything customer-facing. A Block verdict stops the change.
2. Agents never deploy to production by themselves. A human merges and releases, and the Friday production deploy ban applies to agents exactly as it applies to people.
3. Every agent-written pull request needs a human reviewer from the owning team, and the PR description says which agent wrote it.
4. Agents get read-only credentials. No agent may hold production database write access or customer data exports.
5. Agents must not paste customer data, secrets or Sakura payloads into prompts.

## Who to ask
Mei Tan for the policy, Jiwon Park for agent credentials and security exceptions.
